notes.title: Update
notes.notes:
Hi friends,


It's time for an Update #2 of the game!

- New location “Miami Beach” with a motorcycle and new tasks

- New location “Night Club”, which can be accessed after completing all levels

- Added a couple of new characters in the locations

- Fixed minor bugs

notes.title: Update
notes.notes:
Hi friends,


It's time for an update of the game!

- New mechanics of riding a motorcycle in the forest location

- Some objects were changed on the game locations to fit in more with the atmosphere of the game

- Fixed minor bugs

- Minor changes to some aspects of the game

notes.title: Release of TRADING CARDS and BIG SALE!
notes.notes:
Friends!

Finally Steam approved our trading cards, backgrounds, emoticons and badges!

In total, 5 badges (+1 metal), 12 cards, 5 emoticons and 9 backgrounds were added.

CHECK IT OUT IN POINT SHOP 🐺

More information on trading cards, backgrounds and emoticons - Here 🦊


To get one trading card, you need to spend 5 minutes in the game


We look forward to your feedback in the comments and discussions!

Thank you for your help and support on the way to obtaining these trading cards!
